area: Testbed consistency: one authoritative nav grid

find.report_claim: cycles 182 and 193 built two different nav grids from the same shipped level; an AI consumer asking the route report and the authoring report got different blocked sets
find.live_evidence: measured before the fix: nav_plan_report blocked_cells 143 (cover-only rasterization) versus nav_authoring_report blocked 244 (collider authoring including walls); both still found a 14-step route
find.consumer_evidence: after the fix both reports and the shared helper report 244 blocked cells with the same start, goal and 14-step route

read: tests/test_keystone_navigation_mechanics.py and test_keystone_nav_authoring_mechanics.py (no exact cell pins, so unification was safe)
killed: keeping both derivations: two sources of truth for one level would silently diverge when a wall moves
loosening the new parity assertion: that would hide the very drift this cycle is about; the old derivations were restored in a mutation instead
changing grid_from_boxes or sim.colliders: the engine module is not ours to edit and the colliders are the sim's physics truth
analyze.survivor: a private _nav_grid(clearance) helper using Keystone's grid_from_boxes with floor filtering, used by both nav_plan_report and nav_authoring_report

fix.shooter: shooter/game.py adds ShooterGame._nav_grid(), routes nav_plan_report and nav_authoring_report through it, and drops the duplicated cover rasterization; tests/test_keystone_nav_unification_mechanics.py (4 tests) pins blocked-set parity, route parity, helper authority and sim isolation; README tree names the new test

shooter.failing_first: 3 of 4 new tests failed before the helper existed (AttributeError: no _nav_grid), plus the blocked-set parity mismatch 143 vs 244
shooter.measured: both reports now 244 blocked cells, same start (20,28), goal (20,14), 14-step route; helper reported 244
shooter.mutation: restoring cover-only rasterization in nav_plan_report fails 2 of 4 tests; game.py restored byte-identically (sha256 a90cfb5a837cda09d54a8b7f7ab54d3181bd2cb711962a9f5a1b6f156d068734)
